name: Asou Shunsuke
source:
A scenario writer. He was asked to plan and write a game for bishojo game  and was present for the recording.

When he was unknown, Yukari had undermined his scenario and he lost his job for a while. She has now changed her name and returned to the industry.

He is now active mainly in the adult writing field. Behind his smile, he has a sadistic personality that hides a selfish and insidious nature.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio/index.html]official site[/url]]
